**[[Odesa strikes (2022–present)|Odesa strikes]]
***Four people are killed and 28 others are injured in a [[Russia]]n [[missile]] strike in [[Odesa]]. [[Ukraine]] says that Russia used an [[9K720 Iskander#Iskander-M|Iskander-M]] [[ballistic missile]] with a [[Cluster munition|cluster]] [[warhead]] in the attack. **Five [[Maute Group|Dawla Islamiya]] militants are killed and three [[Philippine Army|soldiers]] are wounded during two [[shootout]]s in [[Munai]], [[Lanao del Norte]], [[Philippines]]. The military were hunting the group's leader, Nasser Daud, who however escaped from the scene.
